### 1. One neutral data contract, no new policy module

Put the following **type-only declarations** in existing `src/shared/contracts/ir-unit-inventory.ts`, next to the source/unit contracts, importing `IrBindingId` from the existing identity contract as necessary. This is a finite extension of the existing source ownership contract, not a new module/registry or an import from frontend code into the IR. It creates an additional real historical population dependency change; root's C1 successor must include it. The names and fields below are the cross-writer API; implementations must not independently invent competing payloads.

```ts
export interface IrSourceMapSpan {
  readonly start: number;
  readonly end: number;
}
export type IrSourceMapStageProducer =
  | "define" | "stdin-prelude" | "iterator-prelude" | "listformat-prelude"
  | "cjs-rewrite" | "eval-super-rewrite" | "imports";
export interface IrSourceMapTextEdit {
  readonly input: IrSourceMapSpan;
  readonly removed: string;
  readonly inserted: string;
  readonly kind: "replacement" | "generated-insertion";
}
export interface IrSourceMapTextStage {
  readonly producer: IrSourceMapStageProducer;
  readonly inputText: string;
  readonly outputText: string;
  readonly edits: readonly IrSourceMapTextEdit[];
}
export interface IrSourceMapTextProjection {
  readonly originalText: string;
  readonly analyzedText: string;
  readonly stages: readonly IrSourceMapTextStage[];
}
export interface IrSourceMapSource {
  readonly sourceId: IrSourceId;
  readonly sourceKey: string;
  readonly originalFileName: string;
  readonly mapName: string;
  readonly projection: IrSourceMapTextProjection;
}
export interface IrSourceMapPoint {
  readonly sourceId: IrSourceId;
  readonly donorUnitId: IrUnitId;
  readonly analyzed: IrSourceMapSpan;
  readonly original: IrSourceMapSpan;
  readonly mapping: "exact" | "rewrite";
}
export interface IrSourceMapSourceOrigin {
  readonly kind: "source";
  readonly point: IrSourceMapPoint;
  // Innermost-to-outermost actual inlining calls, absent when not inlined.
  readonly inlinedAt?: readonly IrSourceMapPoint[];
  // Additional actual causal source points; primary is always point above.
  readonly contributors?: readonly IrSourceMapPoint[];
}
export type IrSourceMapGeneratedOrigin =
  | { readonly kind: "generated"; readonly phase: "frontend";
      readonly role: "insertion" | "implicit-return" | "binding-scaffold";
      readonly ownerUnitId: IrUnitId; readonly cause?: IrSourceMapPoint }
  | { readonly kind: "generated"; readonly phase: "middleend";
      readonly role: "cfg-scaffold" | "representation-scaffold";
      readonly ownerUnitId: IrUnitId; readonly cause?: IrSourceMapPoint }
  | { readonly kind: "generated"; readonly phase: "async";
      readonly role: "state-dispatch" | "frame-access" | "capability" | "continuation";
      readonly ownerUnitId: IrUnitId; readonly cause?: IrSourceMapPoint }
  | { readonly kind: "generated"; readonly phase: "backend";
      readonly role: "control-scaffold" | "abi-scaffold";
      readonly ownerUnitId: IrUnitId; readonly cause?: IrSourceMapPoint }
  | { readonly kind: "generated"; readonly phase: "support";
      readonly role: "runtime-body" | "runtime-adapter";
      readonly bindingId: IrBindingId }
  | { readonly kind: "generated"; readonly phase: "startup";
      readonly role: "adapter"; readonly sourceIds: readonly IrSourceId[] };
export type IrSourceMapOrigin = IrSourceMapSourceOrigin | IrSourceMapGeneratedOrigin;
export interface IrPreparedSourceMap {
  readonly schema: "prepared-ir-source-map-v1";
  readonly sources: readonly IrSourceMapSource[];
}
```

All offsets are safe integers measured in TypeScript/JavaScript UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes. Text edits use half-open ranges and store actual removed/replacement text. Stages are ordered oldest-to-newest; zero stages means **exact text identity**. The first input equals originalText, consecutive output/input strings are equal, and the last output equals analyzedText. Stage edits are ordered by input position and replay left-to-right without overlap; equal-position insertions are allowed only in their actual emission order and must replay exactly. A generated-insertion has an empty input/removed span; replacement has a nonempty input interval. Every removed string equals its input slice. Empty/no-op edits are omitted. A stage may be omitted only when both text and mapping are actually unchanged. Validation must retain legitimate multiple define passes; it cannot collapse their order.

Catalog `sources` is the exact existing inventory order and source-ID population, including empty files and library/synthetic sources actually admitted to that program. `sourceKey` and `originalFileName` equal the inventory fields. `mapName` is exactly the inventory `sourceKey`; duplicates/conflicting source identities refuse. The compiler-owned association from raw input path to actual SourceFile establishes content identity before this canonical name is chosen. There is no basename or opportunistic `./` stripping fallback. The mapper uses mapName only after that join, so the observed content-key bug cannot recur.

A source `point` always joins an existing donor unit/source. `mapping:"exact"` means the entire analyzed range projects through untouched portions of every stage to exactly the original range. `mapping:"rewrite"` identifies the actual replaced expression/statement range as a **causal span**, not a fictitious character-exact token inside replacement bytes. A source origin maps to the start of its authentic original span. Pure inserted prelude code is generated; a source-written identifier replaced by a compiler binding can retain the actual original identifier span as rewrite provenance. A span crossing multiple edits may project to their genuine enclosing original node span only when the frontend has that actual AST/source relation; it must not guess a minimum/maximum from unrelated replacements. Unknown projection returns a located gap.

`inlinedAt` is a finite genuine call chain (no cycles or repeated invented frame); contributors are finite actual source points, deterministic order, excluding the primary point and exact duplicates. Neither is a substitute for primary attribution. No per-instruction unique hash, global provenance registry, guessed symbol-name map or mutable side table is required. The source catalog and origin-bearing site data together are the complete persisted map payload; there is no redundant integer "covered" count capable of certifying itself.

### 3. Concrete frontend projection APIs and real edit authority

`src/position-map.ts` owns this requested-only method on an **uncomposed single-stage** PositionMap:

```ts
captureSourceMapStage(
  producer: IrSourceMapStageProducer,
  inputText: string,
  outputText: string,
): IrSourceMapTextStage;
```

It reads that instance's actual private edits, derives each inserted string from the actual output slice using accumulated length deltas, copies the exact removed input slice and classifies empty-input insertion versus replacement. It verifies complete replay before returning a frozen plain-data stage. A nonidentity composed map (`inner` chain) is refused by this method: intermediate replacement bytes no longer exist there. It must not call `toInputOffset` to manufacture them or flatten several edits into a guessed rewrite.
